		<div class="overlay">
			
				
						<h1 class="headline">Pousada Maré Alta – Parajurus Kitesurfing &amp; Wingfoiling Hostel, Brazil</h1>
					
			
			
		</div>
	</div> 
    </header>
        
    <main class="container">
   		
    

            <div id="c18123" class="frame frame-default frame-type-1col frame-layout-0">
                
                    <a id="c18128"></a>
                
                
                    



                
                
                    






                
                
        <div class="section">
            
                
                    
    

            <div id="c18125" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0">
                
                    <a id="c18126"></a>
                
                
                    



                
                
                    






                
                

    <p>Pousada Maré Alta is a wonderful place to stay in Parajuru on Brazil’s northeast coast—right on the grounds of KBC Parajuru. Eight rooms with private bathrooms, a pool nestled among palm trees, and breakfast served in the on-site Maré Alta restaurant. It’s just a two-minute walk from your bed to the kite spot. Guests staying here have access to accommodations, a kite school, and the kite spot all on one property.</p>
<p><strong>✔︎ 8 rooms</strong> – each with its own open-air bathroom<br><strong>✔︎ Pool and sun deck</strong> in the enchanting garden<br><strong>✔︎ Breakfast buffet</strong> at the Maré Alta restaurant included<br><strong>✔︎ </strong>Right on the Parajuru kite spot — <strong>free storage</strong> at the KBC Center<br><strong>✔︎ Air conditioning, Wi-Fi,</strong> and <strong>daily housekeeping</strong><br><strong>✔︎ </strong>Family- and child-friendly<br><strong>✔︎ </strong>Kite season from July to February with consistent trade winds</p>


                
                    



                
                
                    



                
            </div>

        


                
            
        </div>
    
                
                    



                
                
                    



                
            </div>

                Rooms

    <p>Eight rooms, all on the ground floor, nestled within the tropical gardens. Each room features a covered terrace with a seating area and a hammock. Inside, natural ventilation and air conditioning ensure comfortable temperatures, along with a TV, refrigerator, and electric kettle.</p>


                
                    



                
                
                    



                
            </div>

Towels and soap are provided, and the bathroom is cleaned daily.<br>Each apartment is named after one of our KBC locations—a tribute to the Geschwister kite schools around the world:</p>

		</header>
	



                
                

    <p>All prices include the daily breakfast buffet from 7:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.</p>
<p>Prices are valid from February 1, 2026, through January 31, 2027 (subject to change).</p>
<h3>Discounts</h3>
<p>The longer you stay at Poudasa Maré Alta, the cheaper it gets:<br>5% discount for 15–20 days, 8% discount for 22–29 days, 10% discount for more than 30 days</p>


                
                    



                
                
                    



                
            </div>

        


                
            
        </div>
        <div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-6 col-md-6">
            
                
                    
    

            <div id="c990454" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0 frame-space-before-medium">
                
                    <a id="c990455"></a>
                
                
                    



                
                
                    




	



                
                

    <h3><strong>General Cancellation Policy/Cancellation Fees</strong></h3>
<p>22+ days before scheduled arrival: free<br>21–8 days: 25%<br>8–1 day: 50%<br>On the day of arrival or later: 100%<br>&nbsp;</p>

                    <div class="box">
		
			<div class="teaser-image-wrap">
				
						
							
									<img class="img-responsive" alt="Breakfast at Pousada Maré Alta Parajuru" loading="lazy" src="/fileadmin/user_upload/Contentpictures/pics/kbc_brazil_pousada_breakfast_01.jpg" width="738" height="540" />
								
						
					
				
			</div>
		
		

		<div class="text-wrap">
			<h3>Breakfast included</h3>
			<p>Breakfast is served every morning from 7:30 to 10:30 at the Maré Alta Restaurant. The continental buffet features seasonal tropical fruit, fresh rolls, pastries, cold cuts, cheese, jams, and honey. It also includes espresso, latte macchiato, hot chocolate, tea, fresh-squeezed juices, and açaí bowls. Omelets, pancakes, and regional specialties are prepared fresh to order.</p>
<p>Breakfast at Pousada Maré Alta is included.</p>
			
					
				
		</div>		

	</div>
                
                    <div class="box">
		
			<div class="teaser-image-wrap">
				
						
							
									<img class="img-responsive" alt="Churrasco nights: a variety of meats on meter-long skewers, served with farofa, macaxeira, and beijão" loading="lazy" src="/fileadmin/user_upload/Contentpictures/Parajuru/Pousada/pousada-mare-alta_parajuru-brasilien-restaurant.jpg" width="738" height="540" />
								
						
					
				
			</div>
		
		

		<div class="text-wrap">
			<h3>Maré Alta Restaurant</h3>
			<p>For lunch and dinner, the à la carte restaurant Maré Alta serves Brazilian and international dishes. The highlight of the week is Valber’s churrasco evenings: various cuts of meat on meter-long skewers, served with farofa, macaxeira, and beijão—a slice of Brazilian culinary culture that’s a must-try.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Pizza nights, sushi evenings, and BBQs round out the program.</p>
			
					
				
		</div>		

	</div>

                            </div>
                        

                        
                        

                        <div class="text-wrap">
                            <h3>Pool</h3>
                            <p>A beautiful pool with sun loungers, next to the covered chillout and stretching area. A perfect place to relax for the whole family. Additional open-air lounge area with seating, billiards and table tennis. With us everyone will find their favorite place.</p>
                        </div>

		<div class="text-wrap">
			<h3>Bathroom</h3>
			<p>All rooms have a private en-suite bathroom and a small outdoor garden.<br>All bathrooms are spacious and equipped with a toilet, sink, soap, towels, and a hot-water shower. The Dakhla, Sicily, and Sal apartments feature a comfortable whirlpool tub.</p>
			
					
				
		</div>		

	</div>
                
                    <div class="box">
		
			<div class="teaser-image-wrap">
				
						<a href="/en/brazil/" target="_blank" title="More about KBC Parajuru">
							
									<img class="img-responsive" alt="Accommodation right on the Parajuru kite spot" loading="lazy" src="/fileadmin/user_upload/Contentpictures/Parajuru/kbc_Parajuru_kitebeach_Aerial_2.jpg" width="750" height="503" />
								
						</a>
					
				
			</div>
		
		

		<div class="text-wrap">
			<h3>Right next to the Parajuru kite spot</h3>
			<p>Pousada Maré Alta is located on the grounds of KBC Parajuru. It’s just a few steps from your room to the kite gear, and less than a minute from the gear to the water. The spot in Parajuru offers flat water behind the sandbar for beginners, a wide lagoon for learning, and open waves for advanced riders—all complemented by consistent trade winds between July and February.</p>
<p>Guests staying at the Pousada receive free storage and equipment service at KBC Parajuru. Your gear stays safe on-site, and the walk to the water is always short.</p>
			
					<a href="/en/brazil/" target="_blank" title="More about KBC Parajuru" class="internal-link kitesurf">More about KBC Parajuru</a>

                <div class="ce-bodytext">
                    
                    <p>Parajuru is located in the state of Ceará, about 130 kilometers east of Fortaleza on Brazil’s northeast coast. The nearest international airport is Fortaleza (FOR). The nearest airport is <strong>Fortaleza</strong>. It is served by flights from many major airports in Germany (Frankfurt, Bremen, Dresden, Düsseldorf, Friedrichshafen, Münster/Osnabrück, Hanover), Switzerland (Basel), and Austria (Graz), for example by Condor and TAP.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The flight time is approximately 9–10 hours.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The drive from Fortaleza to Parajuru takes about 90 minutes. Our transfer service will be happy to pick you up from the airport. You can book the transfer service right away.</p>
<p><a href="/en/brazil/#c15543" class="internal-link fancyframe" target="fancyframe">We’ll find the best travel package for you.</a></p>
                </div>

                <div class="ce-bodytext">
                    
                    <p><strong>Pick-up from the</strong> airportWe <br>are happy to organize your transfer from the airport to Parajuru. The transfer service driver will be waiting for you at the exit of the arrivals hall. He will be carrying a sign with your name on it. He will take you and, if necessary, your equipment safely to the station or hotel, whichever you prefer. With us, you will usually reach your destination in about 1 1/2 hours in an air-conditioned car or minibus.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Return trip to </strong><br><strong>the</strong> airportFor the return trip, you can be picked up either at the kiteboarding club or at a hotel of your choice.<br>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>Transfers to popular destinations</h3>
<p><span class="table-styled">Our driver will also be happy to take you to the most popular destinations nearby:</span></p>
<p><span class="table-styled"><strong>Ilha do </strong></span><br><span class="table-styled"><strong>GuajiruQuiet</strong></span> kite paradise with a large lagoon – perfect for kitesurfing, wing foiling, and relaxing days by the water.</p>
<p><span class="table-styled"><strong>Pontal</strong></span>Small<br>, authentic spot with constant wind, popular with kitesurfers away from the crowds.</p>
<p><span class="table-styled"><strong>Canoa </strong></span><br><span class="table-styled"><strong>QuebradaLively</strong></span> seaside resort with red cliffs, a beautiful beach promenade, bars, restaurants, and nightlife.</p>
<p><span class="table-styled"><strong>Icaraí</strong></span>Relaxed<br> coastal town near Fortaleza, known for its beaches, sunsets, and good kiting.</p>
<p><span class="table-styled"><strong>Jericoacoara</strong></span>I<span class="table-styled"><strong>conic</strong></span><br> natural paradise with dunes, lagoons, and strong winds – a top destination for kiters, adventurers, and sunsets.</p>

		<header>
			




    
            <h2 id="" class="">
                Frequently Asked Questions About Kitesurfing in Brazil and Accommodations
                
            </h2>
        



			



			



		</header>
	



                
                

    <h3><strong>When is the best time for kitesurfing in Parajuru?</strong>&nbsp;</h3>
<p>The peak season runs from July to February. During these months, the trade winds blow steadily at 15 to 25 knots, and on many days even stronger. The months with the most consistent winds are September, October, and November.</p>
<h3><strong>How far is the pousada from the kite spot?</strong>&nbsp;</h3>
<p>Pousada Maré Alta is located right on the grounds of KBC Parajuru. It’s a one-minute walk from your room to the center, and just a few minutes’ walk to the water.</p>
<h3><strong>Is the Pousada suitable for families with children?</strong>&nbsp;</h3>
<p>Yes. The El Gouna double apartment can accommodate up to seven people, the KBC kite school offers its own courses for children and teens, and the pool is accessible to the whole family.</p>
<h3><strong>Can I rent kite and wingfoil equipment on-site?</strong>&nbsp;</h3>
<p>Yes. KBC Parajuru offers kites, boards, wings, and foils from all major brands for rental. Guests of the Pousada pay no storage or service fees.</p>
<h3><strong>How do I get from Fortaleza to Parajuru?</strong>&nbsp;</h3>
<p>Fortaleza Airport (FOR) is about 130 kilometers away; the transfer takes 2 to 2.5 hours, depending on traffic. We can arrange a transfer directly from the airport upon request.</p>
<h3><strong>What languages are spoken locally?</strong>&nbsp;</h3>
<p>The team speaks Portuguese, Polish, and English.<br>&nbsp;</p>
